Subject: Fwd: Missed review — suggested response + quick redline summary

Jordan —

Quick notes from my side after skimming the SOW_Redlines_v2.pdf:
- Section 3.2 (Data handling): propose tightening the customer data deletion clause to 30 days after termination — redline attached (SOW_Redlines_v2.pdf).
- Section 6 (Liability): limit liability to aggregate fees paid in prior 12 months — standard for enterprise; leave room to discuss in call.
- Add a sub-clause to encryption requirements referencing KMS/HSM integration (they asked about on-prem options previously).

Suggested reply to Karen: acknowledge the miss, propose two concrete slots, ask them to confirm who from legal will join, and offer to pre-fill the procurement spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow. I can join the rescheduled call if you want.

I'll attach a clean redline snapshot for quick reference.

- Laura
